subject: Request: short-term credit bridge for ClearTrack RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@cleartrack.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cleartrack.ai
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost profile you showed. We have our RFP bake-off next Tuesday and the evaluation team has asked for a short-term top-up of credits so we can run a two-day, head-to-head benchmark against the incumbent.

Can Redwood make an extra 150k token credits available for a 7-day window? Procurement would need a written note outlining terms (usage window, data controls, and a mutual-action plan). If we can get that, we should be able to accelerate to an internal decision by mid-May.

Thanks,
Sara

Sara Brooks
Sr. AI Platform PM | ClearTrack AI

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@cleartrack.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Hi Sara — great to hear the demo landed well.

We can support a short-term credit bridge for competitive bake-offs in most cases. Tentative plan: 150k tokens allocated to a temporary project key, valid for 7 days from activation, with standard redwood audit logs enabled and no model weights or query data shared outside of ClearTrack. We typically protect against misuse by requiring a signed short SOW or credit terms PDF plus a mutual action plan.

I attached a simple credit-terms PDF and a mutual-action plan template to this thread — feel free to share with procurement and I can loop in Finance for approval.

Next steps I suggest:
- Procurement reviews the attached terms and confirms any edits (DocuSign link if ok)
- I’ll open an internal approval with Finance; Ben will be on the thread for sign-off
- We activate the project key the day before your bake-off start date (you confirm the activation timestamp)

If procurement needs a different duration or token count, tell me and we’ll try to work it out.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-credit-terms.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); CTAI-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Looping in per Soojin's note. A few Finance constraints we need to call out before committing:

1) Max promotional allocation without exec approval: 200k tokens for up to 14 days. Anything beyond that needs approval from revenue ops.
2) We require the signed credit-terms PDF in DocuSign or an internal procurement note from the customer with explicit acceptance of terms.
3) We will add a line item on the CRM deal for the credit allowance and mark it as non-billable promotional.

If ClearTrack confirms 150k / 7 days and returns the signed terms, I can approve from Finance side. Lauren, please confirm if this aligns with the regional playbook.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Ben — approved for the 150k token bridge, 7 days, promotional (non-billable). Please insist on the signed terms before activation.

Force-multipliers / notes for sales: prioritize activation window accuracy (start-of-day PST) and include a short note in the mutual-action plan describing the exact tests to be run (latency, throughput, and quality prompts).

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, West Coast Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@cleartrack.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Hi Sara — Ben from Redwood Finance here. Per our approval, we can provision 150,000 token credits for a 7-day window.

Attached is the credit-terms PDF pre-filled and a DocuSign link to sign. Key points: credits expire after 7 days from activation, logging/audit trail retained for 90 days, credits are promotional and non-refundable.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/ctai-credit-terms
Attachments: proposed-credit-terms.pdf

If you sign today, Soojin will schedule activation for Monday 2027-04-12 08:00 PDT (per your bake-off start date). Please confirm and return signed doc.

Best,
Ben

From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@cleartrack.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cleartrack.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Thanks Ben — signature completed and uploaded via the DocuSign link this morning. Procurement attached an internal confirmation and our test plan to the mutual action plan spreadsheet.

We confirm activation for Mon 2027-04-12 08:00 PDT. One ask: will you enable per-route token breakdown in the logs so our engineers can map requests to prompts? That helps our post-bake analysis.

Sara
Sara Brooks
Sr. AI Platform PM | ClearTrack AI
Attachments: CTAI-procurement-confirmation.pdf (procurement note)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@cleartrack.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: extra eval credits for upcoming bake-off

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sara. Ben: can you confirm the CRM entry and promotional tagging have been applied? Also, ops request: Ops/Runtime will enable per-route token breakdown and a temporary project key. I will confirm the key and activation timestamp first thing Monday.

Sara — we will also surface the logs to your engineers via a secure share for the 90-day retention window. Expect the project key and activation email on Monday morning. Good luck with the bake-off — ping me immediately if you hit any unexpected quota issues.

Cheers,
Soojin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
